content: Root cause: The bug was caused by calling `pci_disable_device()` on a PCI device that had not been successfully enabled due to a failure in `pci_enable_device()` or `pci_enable_device_mem()`. This resulted in a warning being triggered because the device was not in an enabled state when the disable function was called. The patch corrects this by returning immediately if enabling the device fails, thus avoiding the unnecessary call to disable a device that was never enabled.
